name: matrix-paychain
description: Bursts of ordinary wallet payments on the Matrix line (weak-blocks), where the wallet may spend unconfirmed change: accepted payments that end neither confirmed nor in the miner's pool are lost. A run below the activity floor (accepted < 3/4 of 40) is INCONCLUSIVE. Predicates fitted to GitHub Actions run 36597517108 (base lost in 5/5, base + ergoplatform/ergo#2504 in 0/5).
